name: Sugar Daddies
source:
It is the story of a group of young girls who are supported by sugar daddies. The story takes place on "Auro Digger Island." "Auro" is the Samoan word for gold. You will play as the third party Master of Ceremonies, and make decisions for most of the characters in the game.

The central character is a girl named, "Dawn." The player can edit this name to suit their own tastes. "Dawn"  has been lied to, and betrayed by everybody close to her. The player's decisions will directly influence the actions of the various potential Sugar Daddies, and how "Dawn" evolves.

[From Patreon]
translation:
这是一个关于一群年轻女性接受“糖爹”供养的故事。舞台是“Auro淘金岛”，“Auro”在萨摩亚语中意为黄金。你将扮演置身事外的主持人，为游戏中大多数角色做出决定。

核心角色是一名叫“多恩”的女孩，玩家可以按喜好更改她的名字。她身边的所有亲近之人都曾欺骗、背叛她。玩家的决定将直接影响各位潜在糖爹的行动，以及多恩的变化与成长。

[摘自Patreon]
